stage.name: Rolling Sands
stage.description:
One thing common to the Rat King, Withered Knight, and The Big, Ugly Thing is that they are all strong and silent. If they can speak at all, that is...

<Orientation Trial>Use a pre-picked squad of 5 Operators.

tiacauh_guard.name: Tiacauh Guard
tiacauh_guard.flavourText: A braver, fiercer warrior who uses a crude spear to attack. Years of training have given these warriors tough physiques, and they fear not even the fiercest attacks.
abilities: Gains DEF when blocked.

vicious_training_gloompincer.name: Vicious Training Gloompincer
vicious_training_gloompincer.flavourText: Infected creatures commonly found in the great lakes and rivers of Kazimierz, these male gloompincers are fed special hormones and made more aggressive than the regular ones. They're a cruel tool to train knights and entertain fight spectators.

elite_sicilian.name: Elite Sicilian
elite_sicilian.flavourText: A basic melee combatant with higher combat capabilities than a normal Sicilian. These Siracusans adorn themselves with an ancient name, symbolizing the glory of an era bygone.

sponsor_drone.name: Sponsor Drone
sponsor_drone.flavourText: Ellen Select Technology thanks you for your sponsorship! This quick and affordable drone carries the passion of the fans, bringing anything to the knights on the field: traps, explosives, medicine, or even snacks! The outcome of the battle is in your hands!
abilities: Flying unit.
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
When destroyed, grants a deployable unit

elite_brawler.name: Elite Brawler
elite_brawler.flavourText: Exceptionally dangerous combatants who are even more destructive than normal Brawlers. Only the most heavily-armored Operators can withstand their blows.

nameless_elite_knight.name: Nameless Elite Knight
nameless_elite_knight.flavourText: An independent Kazimierz knight with some degree of achievement, though not enough to inspire any confidence. Sooner or later, they'll probably get swallowed up by the competition.

elite_marksman.name: Elite Marksman
elite_marksman.flavourText: Tactical long-range combatants, more dangerous than a normal Marksman. Adept at oppressing enemies with continuous fire, their tactical literacy means they will prefer targeting our command terminal in order to cut off support. Proceed with caution.
abilities: Shoots 3 times in a row
Prioritizes attacking the Command Terminal

blade_helmet_knightclub_trainee.name: Blade Helmet Knightclub Trainee
blade_helmet_knightclub_trainee.flavourText: A trainee from the Blade Helmet Knightclub. This order of young competition knights chose the name of the ancient heroes of Kazimierz. In fact, they exhibit only arrogance and complacency from that extinct lineage. They are good at picking fights and don't go down easily.
abilities: Significantly decreases ATK of the unit with the highest ATK for a period of time
Rebirth

greytail_leader.name: Greytail Leader
greytail_leader.flavourText: The Rat King's elite guard, granted special Originium Arts by the Rat King, allowing him to create a Barrier to protect himself. Movement speed is increased when the Barrier is broken. Stronger in combat than a Greytail.
abilities: DEF significantly increases when the Barrier is present.
Movement Speed significantly increases when the Barrier is destroyed.

tiacauh_champion.name: Tiacauh Champion
tiacauh_champion.flavourText: An incredibly formidable Tiacauh warrior, with the qualifications to become a Warchief. These warriors harbor great pride in their combat abilities, and live for the thrill of the duel no matter where they are. Their single-mindedness allows them to shrug off all outside interference.
abilities: When blocked, this unit will only receive damage from the unit blocking it, and the DEF of both units is decreased.

bulldozer.name: Bulldozer
bulldozer.flavourText: Special melee combatants. Their unstoppable bulk is equivalent to blocking three normal enemies, and Operators who cannot block three enemies may not be able to halt their advance at all. Compared to a normal Bully, they boast greater attack power and armor.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block

rat_king.name: 'Rat King'
rat_king.flavourText: Lin, Lin Gray, the Rat King of the slum. He bears many titles, just like the shifting of the city's shadows underneath his feet. Don't touch the red lines. If you ever have a moment of indecisiveness, whatever it is that you were concerned about will become nothing more than a whisper in the winds above the dunes.
abilities: [Singing Sands] Targets a unit with the highest Max HP, dealing heavy physical damage to the target and nearby allied units within a cross area
[Sand Tomb] Targets a unit with the lowest Max HP, continuously inflicting Arts damage to the target and nearby allies, also reducing their ATK
Appears with a Barrier that can absorb a large amount of Arts damage, gains significantly increased DEF while Barrier is active
Deals more damage when HP drops below half

the_big_ugly_thing.name: 'The Big Ugly Thing'
the_big_ugly_thing.flavourText: Zumama's magnum opus, a massive mechanical monster piloted by the High Priest. It can strike both in melee range and from a distance, capable of easily destroying Giant Mushrooms and Stumps. Normal engineers cannot even fathom how a machine slapped together haphazardly like this can even move, but move it indeed does.
abilities: First Form
Ranged attacks deal Splash damage, Melee attacks deal more damage
Periodically destroys Giant Mushrooms and Stumps, rendering them unable to be deployed upon
When HP drops to 0, it will explode, Stunning units in a large area and ejecting its pilot, the High Priest
High Priest Form
Will not attack, cannot be blocked, and takes True damage every second

corrupted_knight.name: Corrupted Knight
corrupted_knight.flavourText: A Sarkaz knight with a broken horn who radiates terror and shows clear signs of excessive drug use. Uses a warhammer in battle. Crushes enemies with terrifying bloodlust. When the Withered Knight falls, takes up the quest and becomes dramatically stronger. Every step he takes spreads corruption.
abilities: Attacks deal Physical damage to the target and adjacent allied units
Does charged attacks, dealing heavy Physical damage to the targets and any adjacent units
Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when <Withered Knight> dies

withered_knight.name: Withered Knight
withered_knight.flavourText: A Sarkaz knight with a broken horn who radiates terror and shows clear signs of excessive drug use. Uses a cursed bow in battle. Can shoot multiple targets at once and plant seeds of withering arts. When the Corrupted Knight falls, takes up the quest and becomes dramatically stronger. Knights that are hostile to him will shift to Wither.
abilities: Attacks 2 targets simultaneously
Fires explosive arrows at three targets which explode after a short delay, dealing high Arts damage to the target and surrounding four tiles
Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when <Corrupted Knight> dies
